verdict.rationale: Unity documents Sentis (com.unity.ai.inference) as its own neural network inference library. It imports trained models and runs them in real time on the target device's compute resources, and a registry probe confirms the package is published on Unity's official UPM registry. Missing for 10: detail on supported model formats and backends (GPU/CPU/NPU) per platform, and independent or hands-on corroboration of in-game inference performance.
